title: Fixed Opposed Curved Comb Jaws and Squeeze Tabs Hair Claw

One jaw has six complete teeth and the other five staggered teeth; neither jaw is assembled from extracted brush pins. Two full flared squeeze-tab exteriors rise from the upper back rails. Four whole annular knuckles alternate along one complete transverse retained pin. All finite geometry newly authored, not a nail clipper with its lever swapped, a pin brush, or a cropped flat marbling comb. Three constant opaque PBR roles, metres Z up and full bounds-centred ground datum. One original whole model zero scenes; teeth and knuckles are not additional assets. Static empty grooming-accessory game art only: spring not represented, no hair, head, pinch action, actual grip, flex, hinge motion, bodily fit, durability, manufacture or safety claim.
